And do NOT flip it into a positive: Aichi tamari is only near-wheat-free, most commercial brands still declare 小麦, and here it is a flavouring sauce, not an allergy accommodation. Correct line: the shop uses tamari shoyu on the wagyu — tamari is not automatically gluten-free; ask which brand.
